title: Thief II
shortDescription: Thief II helps define a PC (Windows) shooter and stealth path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Builds a traceable shooter and stealth option into the PC (Windows) discovery path.
Pairs a frozen GameAtlas catalog method with a direct Wikidata structured-data record.

signals.rationale: Cataloged for the PC (Windows) shooter and stealth discovery path using a Wikidata-listed catalog relationship; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
